## 보관 원문

> # WA EPA Project NeoSmelt Part IV decision
>
> - Official page: https://epa.wa.gov.au/media-statements/proposed-low-emissions-iron-pilot-not-be-formally-assessed-epa
> - Release date: 2026-07-20
> - The Western Australian EPA decided that the proposed Project NeoSmelt pilot at Patterson Road in the Rockingham Industrial Zone would not be formally assessed under Part IV of the Environmental Protection Act 1986.
> - The proposal combines direct reduced iron technology with electric smelting furnace capability.
> - EPA stated that likely environmental effects could be mitigated through other statutory decision-making processes.
> - Noise and air emissions can be managed under the Environmental Protection (Noise) Regulations 1997 and Part V of the EP Act; native vegetation clearing may require a separate clearing permit.
> - The NeoSmelt joint venture comprises BHP, BlueScope, Mitsui Iron Ore Development, Rio Tinto and Woodside Energy.
> - BlueScope described expected production as up to 49,000 tonnes of iron annually.
> - Evidence boundary: a decision not to formally assess under Part IV is not evidence that every statutory approval has been obtained, nor that FID, construction approval, construction, commissioning or operation has occurred.
